findings.claim: MPWR 10-K FY2025：2025 年營收 92% 來自亞洲客戶，風險因子列明貿易法規變動、出口許可、關稅與中美報復性關稅風險。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 92% of our total revenue was from customers in Asia.

findings.claim: MPWR 10-K FY2025：出口管制與關稅至申報日止未對營收與營運造成重大影響，公司稱供應鏈設計可降低關稅衝擊，但限制可能快速且意外頒布。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025 and through the date we filed this Annual Report, no restrictions or requirements have had a material impact on our revenue and operations.

findings.claim: 2026 年 1 月 Section 232 對先進半導體及含其產品課 25% 關稅（2026-01-15 生效），含多項豁免（如美國資料中心用晶片）；搜尋結果未載明 MPWR 產品是否適用。
findings.source: Sec 232 Tariffs on Semiconductors & Their Derivatives Effective Jan 15, 2026 (valexander.com)
